design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 0 (Quintanilla, frozen 2026-12-17 09:40:00 CST) — revision 4

1. Draw: prerequisite_problems=2, factor_counts=[6,5,4] (a multiset) -> combined-program credit 6, late fee 5, advance payment (root) 4.

2. Test. Marisol asks only to pay the rest of Lucia's tuition-based Pre-K year in one portal payment. The advance payment's rule is not fixed until December's late fee is assessed and until the combined-program credit owed on December is posted. December (posted 2026-12-01, due 2026-12-05) carries no payment and no late fee; Lucia's Creek Kids Club Pre-K Wraparound seat (Workforce Solutions funded) started 2026-12-16 and no credit stands on the December charge. The agent reads the tuition ledger, both children's Creek Kids Club records and Lucia's meal account, posts the late fee and the credit, then quotes the advance payment the parent makes herself.

3. Scope: task 0 claims enroll_ext_late_fee_assessment, enroll_ext_combined_program_credit, enroll_ext_advance_payment and their three tools; task 1 claims the other four.

4. Problem-tree card.
- Root -> late fee (value_input, gate ap_open, action form): "The advance payment is not fixed until the late fee owed for the enrollment's most recent billing month, when that month's tuition was left unpaid after its due day, has been assessed." fallback_reason: the schedule can owe nothing (yearly cap already reached) and books no row.
- Root -> combined credit (value_input, gate ap_open, action form): "The advance payment is fixed only after the combined-program credit owed on the most recent billing month has been worked out and posted for a child who attends Creek Kids Club Pre-K Wraparound Care (5 Days)." fallback_reason: the credit can be 0.00 (a later start with nothing added, or the account-standing reduction).
- Falsity at the opening: enrollment_ledger d1b82598 (2026-12 charge) has no payment, credit or late fee; the latest late fee row is 68a18e4d (2026-11); care_enrollments 6963ae45 active from 2026-12-16.
- At step 9 the open balance rises 1051.00 -> 1101.00; at step 11 (after step 9) it falls 1101.00 -> 1043.50.
- Order: the prerequisites commute (the late fee's unpaid-month read stays at the whole 498.00 with or without the credit; the credit's arrears count is 2 months before and after December's fee). Run: late fee 50.00 / credit 57.50 in either order; advance 3409.00 either way.
- Deletion runs: skip step 9 -> 3359.00; skip step 11 -> 3466.50.

5. Factor cards (scratch evalc.py, identical to check_compute). Realism tag per factor (realism_bar.md R1-R5, AMENDMENT 1 R6).
Late fee (50.00; all-baseline 25.00): repeat_lateness_schedule [R1] two earlier fees -> 35.00 (45.00); paper_payment_schedule [R6 payment method] one personal_check -> +10.00 (45.00); unpaid_month_schedule [R6 amount unpaid] whole December unpaid -> flat +15.00 (40.00); yearly_late_fee_cap [R5, method] earlier fees 95.00 -> limit 55.00 (55.00); multi_program_household_cut [R6 children in a program] two active Creek Kids Club enrollments -> 5.00 off after the limit (55.00). No factor depends on the day the desk posts the fee, and no percentage of another price is added to the flat fee.
Combined credit (57.50; all-baseline 40.00): wraparound_funding_tier [R1] CCS-funded -> 20.00 (67.50); care_month_proration [R3] start on day 16 -> half (67.50); combined_tuition_cap [R5, multi-source] 498.00 + 192.00 - 0.00 - 650.00 = 40.00 (17.50); creek_kids_children_tier [R6 children in a program] two active Creek Kids Club enrollments -> 10.00 (47.50); wraparound_registration_lead [R6 lead days] 7 days -> 5.00 (52.50); account_standing_reduction [R6 months in arrears] 2 months -> 7.50 off (65.00).
Advance (3409.00; all-baseline 3458.80): pay_in_full_offer [R1] five months -> half of one month 249.00 in place of the standard 74.70 (3496.15); offer_timing_window [R2] 12 days after the due day -> half (3284.50); arrears_offer_reduction [R6 months in arrears] two months -> 10.00 off the discount (3399.00); creek_kids_household_reduction [R6 children in a program] two children -> 10.00 (3419.00).
Every factor moves its result alone on this world (T1); every factor also moves with all others at baseline on some producible world (T2): no factor gates another (the late fee's reduction applies after the limit, so the cap and the reduction both move the fee; the advance's baseline carries the standard discount, so the timing share and the account-standing reduction act on a non-zero quantity). No two factors cancel (7.50 and 10.00 reductions never equal an addition of the same computation).
Cross-difficulty (care): five factors of the credit, one of the late fee, one of the advance. Multi-source: combined_tuition_cap (enrollment ledger + care seat + care ledger on every non-fall-through tier).
Near-misses / decoys: Mateo's family-paid After-School seat is not a Pre-K Wraparound seat (the funding, proration, cap and lead reads select the student's active Pre-K Wraparound enrollment by student, plan and status); a withdrawn or ended Creek Kids Club enrollment would not count (status active); the September ACH payment is not a paper payment; the October late fee is not the most recent billing month.

6. Base-invariant card. enroll_tuition_late_fee: enroll_prek_tuition's late-fee sentence is retired by a declared overwrite whose replaced_by restates the due day (day 5, or 5 days after a charge that posts after day 5), oldest-first application, one fee per billing month, the earliest posting day and the handling time; a month already carrying a fee, fully paid, or before its earliest posting day owes none. enroll_tuition_credit: no gate. enroll_tuition_payment: the payment-method sentence is retired by the overwrite shared verbatim with the payment-plan policy (each portal-only case named, every other payment keeps all accepted methods). Seeded rows follow the revised schedule: October 40.00 (as of 10-06), November 55.00 (as of 11-06), with only Mateo's Creek Kids Club enrollment active then; the 2026-10-08 check of 538.00 pays October and its fee.

7. Business object: enrollment 4a6eaf93; late fee for billing month 2026-12; credit against charge d1b82598; advance payment on the enrollment. "Most recent billing month" = the latest billing_month carrying a tuition charge (one charge per billing month, so no ties).

8. Seed: profile; Lucia and Mateo; Lucia's enrollment and Mateo's Attendance Zone Enrollment (enrolled at Alder Springs, the record his Creek Kids Club admission rests on); 5 charges, 2 late fees, 3 payments; Lucia's meal account (Paid); two Creek Kids Club enrollments and 15 care ledger rows priced by the care charter (Lucia: registration fee 40.00, seat confirmed on payment, first month 192.00 half month at standard_rate under CCS funding, paid in full by the family on its 2026-12-10 due day because no Workforce Solutions remittance has posted yet, so no care late payment fee is owed; Mateo: 248.00 a month, family-paid, sibling position 1 because CCS-funded seats are not counted, paid by the 10th).

9. Persona: Marisol, rushed, pays the rest of the year from her checking account in the portal herself; identity on request; Creek Kids Club and the unpaid November/December only when asked; consents to postings; pays the quoted amount and closes.

10. Gates: EXTENDED OK, TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK, REPLAY OK, SOLVABILITY OK, COMPUTE OK, GROUNDING OK, SCOPE OK.
user_scenario: You are Marisol Quintanilla, a mother in Calloway Creek whose four-year-old daughter Lucia is in the tuition-based Pre-K class at Sunflower Early Childhood Center. You speak English comfortably on the phone, though Spanish is your first language, and you are warm but a little rushed because you are calling on your break. You open by saying you just got your year-end bonus at work and you want to pay off the rest of Lucia's Pre-K tuition for the school year in one payment today, so you never have to think about it again; you would like the person to tell you the exact amount, because you will make the payment yourself in the district's online parent portal, from my checking account. You never read card or bank numbers to anyone over the phone, and you do not want to use a card for this. When asked who you are, you give your full name, Marisol Quintanilla, and your phone number 5125550183; if they need a second detail you give the last four digits of your driver's license, 5517, and if they ask for your date of birth it is April 22, 1990; your email is marisol.quintanilla@outlook.com. Lucia's student number is 450517 if they ask; your son Mateo, a third grader at Alder Springs, goes to Creek Kids Club after school, which you pay yourself every month. Only if the person asks about Lucia's after-school care do you mention that she started the Creek Kids Club Pre-K wraparound program at Sunflower on Wednesday, December 16, that you signed her up on December 9, and that Workforce Solutions helps pay for it. Only if they ask about November and December do you say you have not paid either month yet because you were waiting for the bonus to pay everything at once, and that you paid October with a personal check at the campus office. You have no idea how the district works out the numbers and you do not guess any amount. If the person tells you something has to be posted or applied to Lucia's account before the final amount can be given, you tell them to go ahead and do it, because you want everything squared away. When the person hands you the portal payment and gives you the amount, you make the payment yourself right then, choosing your checking account (a bank draft), for exactly the amount they gave; once you see the payment confirmation number you read it back, thank them and end the call.
